title: Manager – Social Impact & NGO Partnerships
description:
Manager – Social Impact \& NGO Partnerships

*Ideacraft \& Brandict \| Corporate Merchandise* ***Sustainability***  *Social Impact*

About Ideacraft \& Brandict

Ideacraft is a technology\-driven B2B digital marketplace and sourcing ecosystem for branded merchandise, corporate gifting and employee engagement solutions. We are building a more organized, transparent and scalable way for companies to source, manage and deliver merchandise through technology, automation and a strong supplier network. Our solutions span brand stores, on\-demand gifting, automated gifting, custom kitting and bespoke merchandise.

Brandict is our Dubai\-headquartered private\-label merchandise brand, created for the global promotional products market. It brings together product excellence, sustainability and social impact as three core pillars of every product story. Brandict works with distributors and corporate merchandise partners internationally, with a focus on thoughtful design, responsible materials and products that can communicate a meaningful impact story through QR\-led storytelling.

Across both businesses, we want social impact to be embedded into commerce rather than treated as a one\-time CSR activity. Our objective is to build credible NGO partnerships, support measurable initiatives and enable customers to see how their purchases can contribute to people, communities and a better tomorrow.

The Role

We are looking for a hands\-on Manager – Social Impact \& NGO Partnerships to build and manage the social\-impact ecosystem for Ideacraft and Brandict. The role will identify credible NGOs and social enterprises, evaluate their processes, structure partnerships, coordinate impact programs and convert verified outcomes into authentic stories that can be shared with our customers. This is an execution\-oriented role requiring regular field interaction, strong documentation and the ability to work closely with internal marketing, sourcing, operations and leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

**Identify, meet and evaluate NGOs, foundations, social enterprises and community organizations aligned with education, hunger, livelihood, environment, inclusion and other relevant causes.**

**Conduct basic due diligence on prospective partners, including governance, registrations, utilization of funds, program capability, transparency and evidence of impact.**

**Build a curated network of credible partners across India and, progressively, other markets relevant to Ideacraft and Brandict.**

**Design practical impact programs linked to orders, products or defined campaigns, with clear contribution mechanics, beneficiaries and measurable outcomes.**

**Coordinate with NGO partners on implementation, timelines, documentation, photographs, beneficiary stories, utilization records and periodic impact reporting.**

**Create a simple internal framework to track contributions and outcomes so that customer\-facing impact claims remain accurate, traceable and defensible.**

**Work with marketing and creative teams to convert verified impact into concise website, catalogue, QR\-code and campaign stories without exaggeration or tokenism.**

**Support the Brandict QR\-story proposition by developing authentic social\-impact narratives that can be associated with relevant products and programs.**

**Coordinate employee volunteering, donation drives or community initiatives where these strengthen the overall impact program.**

**Prepare monthly/quarterly dashboards for management covering partners, funds deployed, beneficiaries/outcomes, active initiatives, documentation status and next priorities.**

**Maintain complete records of MOUs, approvals, partner documents, reports and impact evidence; escalate compliance or reputational concerns promptly.**

What We Are Looking For

**3–7 years of relevant experience in CSR, NGO partnerships, social impact, sustainability, foundations, development sector or a comparable role.**

**Strong field orientation — comfortable visiting NGOs and project locations, speaking with beneficiaries and independently validating execution.**

**Good understanding of NGO operations, documentation and basic CSR/compliance processes; ability to distinguish genuine impact from marketing claims.**

**Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and reporting skills.**

**Structured, ethical and detail\-oriented, with a high level of ownership and sensitivity while working with communities and partners.**

**Ability to operate in an entrepreneurial environment and build the function from the ground up.**

Success in This Role

Success will mean building a trusted network of impact partners, establishing a disciplined process for selecting and monitoring initiatives, creating measurable and well\-documented outcomes, and ensuring that every impact story communicated by Ideacraft or Brandict is credible, human and supported by evidence.

**Purpose of the role: Make social impact a measurable part of every relevant order and product story — not an afterthought.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Manager (Sales & Marketing)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Business Development Manager** with 5–8 years of experience in the **tour and travel industry**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, generating revenue, and expanding the company’s customer base.

The candidate should have strong knowledge of the travel industry, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and a proven track record in business development and sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the travel and tourism sector.
* Generate leads through networking, referrals, cold calling, online channels, industry connections, and other business development activities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, B2B partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Understand client travel requirements and coordinate with the operations/team to provide suitable travel solutions.
* Prepare and present travel proposals, packages, quotations, and commercial terms to clients.
* Negotiate pricing and close deals while maintaining healthy margins for the company.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales/revenue targets.
* Develop new B2B and B2C business channels as required.
* Explore opportunities for corporate travel, group tours, leisure travel, domestic/international packages, MICE, and other travel segments.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with prospective and existing clients.
* Track leads, sales pipeline, conversions, and revenue through CRM/MIS.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer preferences, and emerging travel opportunities.
* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Reservations, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of bookings.
* Handle client escalations and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Attend industry events, travel exhibitions, networking events, and client meetings for business development.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase repeat business and referrals.
* Prepare regular business development and sales performance reports for management.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Travel Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience in the tour \& travel industry.**
* Proven experience in business development, sales, or corporate/B2B travel sales.
* Strong existing network within the travel industry will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of travel products, tour packages, destinations, hotels, and travel services.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented with strong business acumen.
* Ability to generate leads independently and convert them into business.
* Strong follow\-up and client\-handling skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM/sales tracking tools.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, business development, and industry events when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* New business generated
* Monthly/annual revenue achieved
* Lead\-to\-client conversion rate
* Number of new corporate/B2B accounts
* Client retention and repeat business
* Gross margin/profitability
* Sales pipeline value
* Collection/payment follow\-up
* Business partnerships developed

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **well\-connected within the travel industry, commercially driven, confident in client interactions, and capable of independently generating and closing business opportunities.** Experience in B2B travel sales, corporate travel, group tours, or travel partnerships would be highly valuable.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Territory Manager - Kolar
description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting\-edge and next\-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.


At FMC, our employees are guided by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture, Solutions for the Planet. We provide farmers innovative solutions that increase the productivity and resilience of their land. From our industry\-leading pipeline to novel biologicals and precision technologies, we are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges.


For more than a century, FMC has successfully delivered some of the of the industry's most advanced, innovative solutions that protect farmers’ crops from destructive pests and disease, while also protecting the environment. We are committed to fulfilling our mission of discovering new herbicide, insecticide and fungicide active ingredients, product formulations and pioneering technologies that are consistently better for the planet.

**Position Summary:**

  

Territory managers are key point of contact between FMC and customers both channel and end users. They are the face of company answering queries, introducing new products and services to customers get orders, follow up and collect the dues. Create demand of the product in their territory with aim of maximizing profit

**Location: Kolar**

**The Role (daily responsibilities):**

* Responsible for Sales and Demand generation focusing on developing \& executing territory’s sales target. The responsibility includes collection and liquidation target for all the key crop and with our product portfolio for the year month by month and quarter by quarter
* Executing product w wise targets based on Strategic Goals
* Meeting the customers regularly on sales visit and field activity
* Demonstrating and presenting our product portfolio and services to the channel and end users
* Devise and implement product strategies for filling the identified market gaps to drive consistent sales
* Developing new customers and strengthening existing customer base for both channel and end users
* Forecasting Sales for product SKU wise and liquidation, achieve accuracy and maintain correct records by updating in the dashboard/portal which are available
* Participating in local trade exhibitions also working with the local KVK’s for branding our portfolio etc
* Develop understanding of competitive landscape and reporting competitor activity and our action on regular basis
* Continuously evaluating the existing channel partners and extending support to them.
* Focus on strengthening the market by identifying new retailers as per the process.
* Effective utilization of resources by prioritizing market units
* Estimate and give the requirement of territory wise MC \& Sample requirement for the year needed to sell and liquidate his annual target
* Coaching and Training of extended team to deliver sales target
* Effective usage of social media and other digital platforms to create awareness in the territory
* Identifying and developing new market segments for portfolio promotion and sales with new business opportunities in the territory
* Monitor the competition in the Territory with respect to their products, customer centric activities and buying trends
**The Candidate (requirements):**

* BSc Agriculture /MSc Agriculture with 2\-3 years’ sales experience in Crop Protection industry / Agrochemical industry
* Experience working in a customer\-focused environment.
* Good consumer and market insights
* Through knowledge of Crop \& Pest Dynamics and Geography.
* Good knowledge of MS Office
* Ability to work with and through other teams/functions such as Sales, Marketing, R\&D and Crop/ Brand Marketing team.
* Very good understanding of customer CTQs
* Creative mind and analytical skills
* Ability to relate to different audiences internal and external including Distributors and Farmers
* **Proficiency in local language mandatory and English Language preferred**

title: Investment Specialist
description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 20 September 2026**Purpose of your role**


The individual will act as an agent for growth of the Systematic Investment business (primarily focussing on Systematic Fixed Income), remain focused on efficiency and profitability and ensure excellence of client service. As a key member of a growing team, the successful candidate will be able to influence how the Systematic proposition evolves to meet client needs. Accordingly, having an entrepreneurial approach which is open to changing how we do things to better support our clients is key to success in this role.

* The individual will join Systematic Investment Group, supporting client\-facing and product activity for Fidelity’s global distribution business. The individual will work closely with the Systematic Investment Group Investment Directors and Investment Specialists liaise with the Portfolio Managers and the global sales force.
* Responsibilities include the production of a wide range of written material to support client engagement. This includes pitch books and product presentations, reporting materials, marketing and training collateral, editorial content and thought leadership, RFP/RFI submissions, competitor analysis and responses to client queries.
* Collaboration with Investment Directors to design, create and enhance collateral to articulate Fidelity’s capabilities \- both on existing investment strategies as well as evolving disciplines.


The individual’s specific responsibilities will include:

* Production of presentation materials, including pitch books and client updates and working with teams globally for onboarding new clients and mandates.
* Working with Fidelity’s internal distribution teams to support their knowledge and promotion of Fidelity Systematic Investment portfolios and broader investment capabilities.
* RFP/RFI support, articulating Fidelity Systematic Investment Group’s investment process and disciplines (both broadly and for specific portfolios.)
* Query resolution, specifically ensuring that ad hoc fund and strategy queries from clients/sales force are answered quickly and accurately, to be done in concert with global team.
* Working with the India\-based Investment Fund Analysts to support regular standard fund reporting requirements.
* As required, cover regular reporting, working with others in the team to analyse performance, attribution and positioning data and articulate investment messages to clients and distribution teams.
* Liaising with colleagues globally to share information and best practice and to help provide information to clients in a range of formats, including written material, internal briefing or training, and participating in client calls or meetings as appropriate.

**Experience and Qualifications Required**

* A client and service focused mindset.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, preferably with experience of working in a large team, and engagement with stakeholders.
* Graduate or higher qualification with significant experience finance industry experience in Systematic fixed income. Some Systematic Equity/Quant experience would be an added advantage.
* Experience in investment writing and content production (in a variety of formats.)
* Broad knowledge of wholesale and institutional client types.
* Excellent capability with Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with financial data \- using Thomson Reuters Datastream, Bloomberg, Eikon and or other third party systems.
* Strong data and analytical skills.

**Desired experience and qualifications**


The core skillsets required for this role are strong commendation skills, an entrepreneurial approach and going the extra mile for clients. However, the following experience and qualifications are also desirable:

* Post graduate qualification in finance or related field.
* Experience range between 5 to 10 years
* Context, understanding of the systematic and quantitative analysis and investment process and its drivers, coupled with a knack and knowledge of various quantitative investment models.
* Knowledge of key institutional client types and their requirements (e.g. insurance, banking and pensions.)
* A grounding in portfolio theory and investment concepts.


While not a pre\-requisite for the role, any additional technical expertise which could assist in the automation of regular tasks is a plus. This could include:

* Basic knowledge of VBA, Python or other programming language.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Research Analyst IND
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Lead Research Analyst will support the Alternative Investments and Manager Research teams by performing investment data analysis, due diligence support, reporting, and operational research activities across both private and liquid alternative investment offerings. The role will partner closely with investment analysts and portfolio research professionals to support ongoing manager monitoring, research projects, investment onboarding activities, and various reporting initiatives.  

This position provides broad exposure to alternative investments, manager research processes, and investment due diligence activities across multiple asset classes. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop investment knowledge while supporting a wide range of research, reporting, and analytical functions for both private and liquid alternative investment strategies.**Key Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly and ongoing monitoring of alternative investment offerings by gathering, validating, and analyzing performance, asset, distribution, redemption, and portfolio\-level data.
* Prepare recurring research reports, dashboards, and analytical materials utilizing internal systems, FactSet, Morningstar, Preqin, Bloomberg, and other third\-party data sources.
* Assist with due diligence activities by reviewing offering documents, RFIs, marketing materials, and manager communications and extracting key information for analyst review.
* Coordinate and maintain investment research databases, due diligence records, SharePoint sites, and document repositories.
* Support manager onboarding, product review, and completion memo processes through data collection, drafting, and documentation.
* Assist with ad hoc analytical projects, including portfolio construction, holdings analyses, risk metrics, and other investment\-related research requests.
* Support recurring private alternatives reporting initiatives, including industry data gathering, performance benchmarking, and market intelligence reporting.
* Participate in manager meetings and introductory calls, documenting key discussion points and maintaining organized records of manager interactions.
* Coordinate the distribution, collection, and tracking of due diligence questionnaires, RFI responses, and related materials.
* Partner with investment research professionals across multiple manager research disciplines to support team initiatives and cross\-functional projects.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of relevant experience in investment research, due diligence, or alternative investments
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), preferably in Finance, Economics, Investments, or related field
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage work independently and prioritize effectively
* Active Series 7 license or ability to obtain within 120 days

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated knowledge of alternative investment strategies and structures
* Prior experience conducting research on private markets (private equity, private credit, real assets)
* High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and intellectual curiosity
* Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex investment concepts
* CFA and/or CAIA designation, or an interest in pursuing one

· overseeing and developing marketing campaigns

· conducting research and analysing data to identify and define audiences

· devising and presenting ideas and strategies

· promotional activities

· compiling and distributing financial and statistical information

· writing and proofreading creative copy

· maintaining websites and looking at data analytics

· organising events and product exhibitions

· monitoring performance

· managing campaigns on social media.
